verdict.rationale: Fern has no documented region or data-residency selection for its hosted platform. The only related evidence is a changelog mention of a self-hosted docs container, which implies customers could run docs on infrastructure they control. That is a workaround, not a residency feature. Missing for 10: hosted region/residency selection, documentation of where Fern stores customer data (including Ask Fern indexes and analytics), self-hosting setup docs, independent corroboration.
